note: expected_result values were produced by executing expected_sql against the warehouse

cases.question: What was the average day-ahead electricity price in 2024?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT avg(price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE year = 2024
cases.explanation: Time-weighted mean of hourly prices for local calendar year 2024.

cases.question: What was the total grid load in 2023 in TWh?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT sum(consumption_mwh) / 1e6 FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE year = 2023

cases.question: What was the highest hourly electricity price in the whole dataset?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT max(price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly

cases.question: What was the lowest hourly electricity price in the dataset?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT min(price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly

cases.question: How many hours had a negative price in 2025?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE year = 2025 AND price_eur_mwh < 0

cases.question: How much solar power was generated in 2024 in TWh?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT sum(solar_mwh) / 1e6 FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE year = 2024

cases.question: What was the renewable share of net generation over the whole period 2023 to 2025?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT sum(renewable_mwh) / sum(total_gen_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly
cases.explanation: Energy-weighted share; averaging hourly shares would be wrong.

cases.question: What was the peak hourly grid load in 2024?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT max(consumption_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE year = 2024

cases.question: How many hours of data are available in total?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly
cases.explanation: Row count of the hourly fact.

cases.question: What was the average residual load in 2025?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT avg(residual_load_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE year = 2025

cases.question: What was the average electricity price on German public holidays?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT avg(price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE is_public_holiday

cases.question: How many negative-price hours were there in July 2024?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE year = 2024 AND month = 7 AND is_negative_price

cases.question: What was the average peak-hour price in 2025?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT avg(price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE year = 2025 AND is_peak

cases.question: How many hours in 2024 had a price above 200 EUR/MWh?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE year = 2024 AND price_eur_mwh > 200

cases.question: What was the average price at 13:00 local time in summer 2024?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT avg(price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE year = 2024 AND season = 'Summer' AND hour_of_day = 13

cases.question: On how many days in 2024 was the daily average price negative?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM marts.mart_market_daily WHERE year = 2024 AND avg_price_eur_mwh < 0

cases.question: How much wind power was generated in December 2024 in TWh?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT sum(wind_mwh) / 1e6 FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE year_month = '2024-12'

cases.question: What was the average electricity price on weekends in 2025?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT avg(price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE year = 2025 AND is_weekend

cases.question: What was the average electricity price per year?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT year, avg(price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly GROUP BY year

cases.question: How many negative-price hours were there in each month of 2024?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT month, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_negative_price) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE year = 2024 GROUP BY month

cases.question: What was the renewable share by season across all years?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT season, sum(renewable_mwh) / sum(total_gen_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly GROUP BY season

cases.question: What is the average electricity price for each hour of the day?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT hour_of_day, avg(price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly GROUP BY hour_of_day

cases.question: How much electricity did each generation source produce in 2025, in TWh?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT source_name, sum(generation_mwh) / 1e6 FROM marts.fct_generation_hourly WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY source_name
cases.explanation: Per source; nuclear has no rows in 2025.

cases.question: What was the monthly price volatility (standard deviation of hourly prices) in 2023?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT year_month, price_stddev_eur_mwh FROM marts.mart_market_monthly WHERE year = 2023

cases.question: What is the average electricity price for each day of the week?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT weekday_name, avg(price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly GROUP BY weekday_name

cases.question: What share of hours had negative prices on weekdays versus weekends?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT is_weekend, avg(CASE WHEN is_negative_price THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly GROUP BY is_weekend

cases.question: What was the average generation of each source during negative-price hours?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT g.source_name, avg(g.generation_mwh) FROM marts.fct_generation_hourly g JOIN marts.fct_market_hourly m USING (timestamp_utc) WHERE m.is_negative_price GROUP BY g.source_name
cases.explanation: Join generation by source to hourly prices.

cases.question: How much lignite was generated (in TWh) in hours when the price was above 200 EUR/MWh?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT sum(g.generation_mwh) / 1e6 FROM marts.fct_generation_hourly g JOIN marts.fct_market_hourly m USING (timestamp_utc) WHERE g.source_name = 'lignite' AND m.price_eur_mwh > 200

cases.question: On the day with the highest average price, how much did each source generate in GWh?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT g.source_name, sum(g.generation_mwh) / 1e3 FROM marts.fct_generation_hourly g WHERE g.local_date = (SELECT local_date FROM marts.mart_market_daily ORDER BY avg_price_eur_mwh DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY g.source_name
cases.explanation: Subquery on the daily mart (2024-12-12), then generation by source.

cases.question: How much natural gas generation (TWh) was there in the month with the highest average price?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT sum(g.generation_mwh) / 1e6 FROM marts.fct_generation_hourly g WHERE g.source_name = 'natural_gas' AND g.year_month = (SELECT year_month FROM marts.mart_market_monthly ORDER BY avg_price_eur_mwh DESC LIMIT 1)
cases.explanation: Monthly mart to find the month, generation table for gas.

cases.question: What was the average price in hours when offshore wind generated more than 6000 MWh?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT avg(m.price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly m JOIN marts.fct_generation_hourly g USING (timestamp_utc) WHERE g.source_name = 'wind_offshore' AND g.generation_mwh > 6000
cases.explanation: Offshore wind is only in the generation table.

cases.question: What was the average hard coal generation per hour in peak versus off-peak hours?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT m.is_peak, avg(g.generation_mwh) FROM marts.fct_generation_hourly g JOIN marts.fct_market_hourly m USING (timestamp_utc) WHERE g.source_name = 'hard_coal' GROUP BY m.is_peak
cases.explanation: Peak flag lives in the market table.

cases.question: How many days had both a negative daily minimum price and a daily maximum price above 200 EUR/MWh?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM marts.mart_market_daily WHERE min_price_eur_mwh < 0 AND max_price_eur_mwh > 200

cases.question: What is the correlation between residual load and the electricity price?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT corr(residual_load_mwh, price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly

cases.question: By what percentage did the average price change from 2024 to 2025?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT 100 * (avg(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE year = 2025) / avg(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE year = 2024) - 1) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly

cases.question: What was the spread between average peak and off-peak prices in each year?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT year, avg(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE is_peak) - avg(price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_peak) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly GROUP BY year

cases.question: Which month had the highest share of negative-price hours?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT year_month FROM marts.mart_market_monthly ORDER BY negative_price_hour_share DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Compare the average price at 14:00 in summer and in winter.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT season, avg(price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE hour_of_day = 14 AND season IN ('Summer', 'Winter') GROUP BY season

cases.question: What was the highest 7-day rolling average of the daily average price, and on which day did it end?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT local_date, r FROM (SELECT local_date, avg(avg_price_eur_mwh) OVER (ORDER BY local_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS r FROM marts.mart_market_daily) x ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 1
cases.explanation: Window function over the daily mart.

cases.question: What was the average price for renewable-share buckets of 0-20%, 20-40%, 40-60%, 60-80% and 80-100%?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT least(floor(renewable_share * 5), 4) AS bucket, avg(price_eur_mwh) FROM marts.fct_market_hourly WHERE renewable_share IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
cases.explanation: Hourly share bucketed into 5 bins; 100% goes to the top bin.
